tickets.title: [P1] Database Services: DB01 read replica replication lag over 15 minutes
tickets.description: Issue: The DB01 read replica fell more than 15 minutes behind the primary during the nightly batch window. Environment: Database Services, PostgreSQL cluster DB01. Reports and dashboards served from the replica showed stale order data.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: the nightly analytics export ran its heavy sequential scans against the replica, saturating disk I/O so WAL replay could not keep up. Resolution: 1) Moved the analytics export to the dedicated reporting replica DB01-R2. 2) Raised max_standby_streaming_delay from 30s to 5min so long queries no longer cancel replay. 3) Replication lag returned to under 5 seconds within 20 minutes.

tickets.title: [P3] Monitoring & Alerts: Replication lag alerting for DB01 (follow-up to INC980101)
tickets.description: Request: Follow-up to INC980101. Add alerting so replication lag on DB01 replicas is caught before reports go stale. Environment: Monitoring & Alerts, Prometheus and Alertmanager.
tickets.resolution_notes: Added a Prometheus alert on pg_replication_lag_seconds > 60 for 5 minutes, routed to the Database Team on-call rotation. Linked the replication lag runbook from the alert. Verified by pausing replay on a staging replica.

tickets.title: [P2] Email & Collaboration: Outbound email queue stuck after SMTP relay certificate expired
tickets.description: Issue: Outbound email stopped leaving the company; about 2,300 messages queued on the SMTP relay. Environment: Email & Collaboration, Postfix relay smtp-relay-01. Partners reported missing invoices and notifications.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: the TLS certificate on smtp-relay-01 expired at midnight, so receiving servers rejected the STARTTLS handshake. Resolution: 1) Installed a renewed certificate. 2) Reloaded Postfix. 3) Flushed the deferred queue; all 2,300 queued messages were delivered by 09:40.

tickets.title: [P3] Security Operations: Automate SMTP relay certificate renewal (follow-up to INC980201)
tickets.description: Request: Follow-up to INC980201. Replace the manual certificate renewal on the SMTP relays with automated renewal and expiry monitoring. Environment: Security Operations, certificate management.
tickets.resolution_notes: In progress: cert-manager issuer configured and tested on smtp-relay-02. Rollout to smtp-relay-01 is scheduled for the next maintenance window. An expiry alert at 21 days before expiry is already active.

tickets.title: [P1] Cloud Services (AWS/Azure/GCP): Checkout API returning HTTP 503 during traffic peak
tickets.description: Issue: The checkout API returned HTTP 503 errors for about 25 minutes during a marketing campaign peak. Environment: Cloud Services (AWS/Azure/GCP), checkout service autoscaling group. Customers could not complete orders.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: the autoscaling group could not add instances because the account's regional vCPU quota was exhausted. Resolution: 1) Requested and received a vCPU quota increase from 256 to 512. 2) Raised the autoscaling group maximum from 24 to 40 instances. 3) Error rate dropped to zero once new instances passed health checks.

tickets.title: [P2] Cloud Services (AWS/Azure/GCP): Capacity review and quota monitoring (follow-up to INC980301)
tickets.description: Request: Follow-up to INC980301. Review checkout capacity planning and add monitoring for cloud quota usage so scaling does not hit a hard limit again. Environment: Cloud Services (AWS/Azure/GCP).
tickets.resolution_notes: Pending: a quota usage dashboard and an alert at 80% of the vCPU quota are in place. Reserved capacity for campaign peaks is awaiting finance approval.

tickets.title: [P2] Backup & Recovery: Nightly backup jobs failing because the backup volume is full
tickets.description: Issue: Nightly backup jobs failed for three nights with 'No space left on device'. Environment: Backup & Recovery, backup server bkp-01. Disk full on the backup volume.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: snapshot retention was still 90 days after the data volume doubled. Resolution: 1) Reduced backup retention from 90 to 30 days. 2) Purged 4 TB of expired snapshots. 3) Re-ran the failed backups successfully.

tickets.title: [P3] Monitoring & Alerts: Prometheus stopped scraping targets because the metrics disk is full
tickets.description: Issue: Dashboards showed gaps and Prometheus stopped scraping targets. Environment: Monitoring & Alerts, Prometheus server mon-01. Disk full on the metrics volume.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: high-cardinality metrics from a new service grew the TSDB faster than planned. Resolution: 1) Reduced TSDB retention from 30 to 15 days. 2) Dropped the high-cardinality request_id label at scrape time. 3) Extended the metrics volume from 200 GB to 500 GB.

tickets.title: [P3] Application Support: Order service crashes because unrotated debug logs fill the disk
tickets.description: Issue: The order service crashed repeatedly on two hosts. Environment: Application Support, order-service. Disk full on /var/log caused by debug logging.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: debug logging was left enabled after a release and logrotate was not configured for the service. Resolution: 1) Set the log level back to INFO. 2) Added a daily logrotate policy keeping 7 compressed files. 3) Added a disk usage alert at 85%.

tickets.title: [P2] Network Infrastructure: Remote users disconnected from VPN every 60 minutes
tickets.description: Issue: Remote users were disconnected from the corporate VPN exactly every hour and had to reconnect. Environment: Network Infrastructure, site-to-client VPN gateways.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: the IPsec phase 2 rekey lifetime differed between the two VPN gateways (3600s vs 28800s), so rekeying failed and sessions dropped. Resolution: aligned the phase 2 lifetime to 28800 seconds on both gateways and enabled dead peer detection.

tickets.title: [P4] Hardware Support: Laptop VPN connection drops when the docking station is connected
tickets.description: Issue: A user's laptop VPN connection dropped every few minutes, but only while connected to the docking station. Environment: Hardware Support, standard engineering laptop with USB-C dock.
tickets.resolution_notes: Root cause: the dock's network adapter firmware toggled between wired and Wi-Fi interfaces under power saving. Resolution: 1) Updated the docking station firmware. 2) Disabled power saving on the dock network adapter. 3) Confirmed a stable VPN session for a full day.

tickets.title: [P3] User Access & Authentication: New hires not receiving MFA enrollment emails
tickets.description: Issue: Three new hires starting this week did not receive their MFA enrollment emails, so they cannot sign in. Environment: User Access & Authentication, identity provider onboarding flow.

tickets.title: [P1] Security Operations: Credential stuffing attack blocked on the customer login page
tickets.description: Issue: Thousands of failed customer logins per minute from a small set of IP ranges. Environment: Security Operations, customer login page behind the WAF.
tickets.resolution_notes: Resolution: 1) Blocked the attacking IP ranges at the WAF. 2) Enabled rate limiting of 5 login attempts per minute per IP. 3) Forced password resets for the 12 accounts with successful logins from those ranges. 4) No further suspicious logins were seen.

tickets.title: [P2] Database Services: Reporting queries on DB02 timing out after schema migration
tickets.description: Issue: Monthly reporting queries on DB02 started timing out after the weekend schema migration. Environment: Database Services, PostgreSQL DB02. Finance cannot run month-end reports.
tickets.resolution_notes: Investigation: the migration dropped the index on orders.created_at, so reporting queries now scan the full table. The index rebuild is scheduled for the Saturday maintenance window; reports can run on DB01-R2 until then.
